import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { compilePrompt } from "../src/compiler.js";
import type { CharacterData, CreativeResolution } from "../src/types.js";
import inputJson from "../examples/example_input.json" with { type: "json" };
import resolutionJson from "../examples/example_resolution.json" with { type: "json" };

test("compiler emits character-first prompt and excludes heritage logic", () => {
  const out = compilePrompt(inputJson as CharacterData, resolutionJson as CreativeResolution);
  assert.match(out.prompt, /CHARACTER FIRST/);
  assert.match(out.prompt, /NUMERIC VISUAL GRAMMAR/);
  assert.match(out.prompt, /SILHOUETTE TEST/);
  assert.match(out.prompt, /MEMORY TEST/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(out.prompt, /HERITAGE FROM PREVIOUS/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(out.prompt, /20% translated Heritage/);
});
